ed_age.source: CDC NSSP ED Visits by Demographics
ed_age.geography: United States only (no state breakout exists)
ed_age.note: Primary pediatric volume proxy. Age bands <1/1-4/5-17.

ed_state.note: Freshest feed. No age breakout -- all ages.

naat_multi.source: CDC NAAT percent positivity by respiratory virus
naat_multi.note: PIV, HMPV, Adenovirus, RV/EV, HCOV, RSV, SARS-CoV-2. NO influenza.

pos_national.source: CDC Percent of Tests Positive for Viral Respiratory Pathogens
pos_national.note: Only live source of influenza positivity. National only.

ari_level.source: CDC Level of Acute Respiratory Illness Activity

respnet.note: Pediatric hospitalization rates per 100k. Severity denominator.

igas.note: Annual only. No weekly public iGAS feed exists. Not a leading indicator.

ww_covid.note: Population-weighted mean concentration. Replaces defunct Biobot feed.

ww_flu.note: Population-weighted mean concentration. Replaces defunct Biobot feed.
